The RPC handler methods that can transitively cause outbound HTTP requests to user-configured URLs are:

1. **`CreateMemo`** (line 70 of `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`) → calls `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook`
2. **`UpdateMemo`** (line 401 of `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`) → calls `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` via `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects`
3. **`DeleteMemo`** (line 527 of `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`) → calls `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook`
4. **`CreateMemoComment`** (line 20 of `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go`) → calls `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook`

**Single convergence function:** `webhook.PostAsync` — `/bench/repo/internal/webhook/webhook.go:184`

All webhook dispatch paths converge at `webhook.PostAsync`, which either directly dispatches the webhook (via `Post`) or enqueues it for asynchronous delivery (line 190 in `webhook.go`). The actual HTTP delivery then occurs in the `Post` function (line 120 of the same file), which uses the protected `safeClient` HTTP client that blocks connections to reserved/private IP addresses.
